title: Post details

fields.label: Summary line
fields.name: dek
fields.instructions: One or two sentences under the title, on cards and in the post hero. Plain text.

fields.label: Topic
fields.name: topic
fields.instructions: Sets the topic pill and the /blog/{topic}/ view the post appears in.

fields.label: Featured
fields.name: featured
fields.instructions: The newest featured post is shown at the top of the blog hub.
fields.message: Feature this guide on the blog hub

fields.label: Updated
fields.name: updated
fields.instructions: Optional. Shown as "Updated …" in the meta bar and the byline.

fields.label: Cover screen
fields.name: cover_screen
fields.instructions: Product screen shown, cropped, on the card and the post cover.

fields.label: Cover zoom
fields.name: cover_zoom
fields.instructions: 1.3 shows the screen just right of the side rail.

fields.label: Cover focus point
fields.name: cover_focus
fields.instructions: CSS position the zoom centres on, for example 24% 33%.

fields.label: Article
fields.name: body
fields.instructions: The article, block by block. Each Heading becomes an entry in the "On this page" list.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: html
sub_fields.instructions: Paragraphs and lists as HTML (p, ul, ol, b, i, a). HTML allowed. Shortcodes such as [rx_link key="pricing"]…[/rx_link] or [rx_plan feat="…"] keep links and plan names live.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Section heading (H2). Each heading becomes an entry in the "On this page" list.

sub_fields.label: Points
sub_fields.name: items
sub_fields.instructions: The "In short" box at the top of the article.

sub_fields.label: Point
sub_fields.name: html
sub_fields.instructions: HTML allowed.

sub_fields.label: Kind
sub_fields.name: kind
sub_fields.instructions: Sets the label and icon.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Optional.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: html
sub_fields.instructions: Paragraphs as HTML. HTML allowed. Shortcodes such as [rx_link key="pricing"]…[/rx_link] or [rx_plan feat="…"] keep links and plan names live.

sub_fields.label: Column headings
sub_fields.name: head
sub_fields.instructions: One heading per line, starting with the heading above the row labels.

sub_fields.label: Cells
sub_fields.name: cells
sub_fields.instructions: One cell per line, starting with the row label. HTML allowed.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: caption
sub_fields.instructions: Shown under the table and used as its accessible name.

sub_fields.label: Highlighted column
sub_fields.name: highlight_col
sub_fields.instructions: Counting the columns after the row labels (1 = first column after the labels). Empty = none.

sub_fields.label: Number columns
sub_fields.name: numeric_cols
sub_fields.instructions: Right-aligned columns, comma-separated, counted the same way. Empty = none.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Optional.

sub_fields.name: a_tag
sub_fields.instructions: Optional pill next to the name.

sub_fields.label: Option B tag
sub_fields.name: b_tag
sub_fields.instructions: Optional pill next to the name.

sub_fields.label: Recommended option
sub_fields.name: winner
sub_fields.instructions: Highlights that column.

sub_fields.label: Verdict
sub_fields.name: verdict_html
sub_fields.instructions: Printed after "Verdict." Optional. HTML allowed.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Shown under "Worked example · illustrative numbers".

sub_fields.label: Note
sub_fields.name: note

sub_fields.label: Rule
sub_fields.name: html

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Shown with the "Print this list" button.

sub_fields.label: Item
sub_fields.name: html
sub_fields.instructions: HTML allowed.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: html
sub_fields.instructions: Paragraphs as HTML. HTML allowed. Shortcodes such as [rx_link key="pricing"]…[/rx_link] or [rx_plan feat="…"] keep links and plan names live.

sub_fields.label: When
sub_fields.name: when
sub_fields.instructions: Optional line under the step, for example "15 minutes".

sub_fields.label: Look
sub_fields.name: kind
sub_fields.instructions: Inline: a slim line with a link. Feature card: points at a feature page. Demo panel: Book a free demo + Start free.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: Plain text.

sub_fields.label: Feature page
sub_fields.name: feature_key
sub_fields.instructions: The button label and icon come from the Features menu.

fields.label: FAQ
fields.name: faq
fields.instructions: "Asked about this" section after the article. Leave empty to hide it.

sub_fields.label: Answer
sub_fields.name: a_html
sub_fields.instructions: Shown inside a paragraph. HTML allowed. Shortcodes such as [rx_link key="pricing"]…[/rx_link] or [rx_plan feat="…"] keep links and plan names live.

sub_fields.label: Confirmed
sub_fields.name: confirmed
sub_fields.instructions: Off: outlined in review mode (?review) and left out of the FAQ schema.
sub_fields.message: This answer is a confirmed fact
